rule: Earth builds stone that stays: its skills raise, use or break your stone, wind up Braced, and break poise.

skills.name: Slingstone
skills.summary: The slowest bolt and the heaviest. It stops what it hits mid-swing and all but staggers it. Thrown into your own stone, it shatters it.
skills.verb_fit: Dig is "tear into the ground and bring stone up to throw": the stone comes out of the floor and goes at them.

good_modifiers.word: Boring Stone: punches through one body and keeps going

bad_modifiers.why: it is already Braced; nothing to add, falls back to a little power
a thrown stone has nothing that lasts; falls back
it acts on what it hits; falls back

skills.name: Landslide Blow
skills.summary: A narrow, slow, crushing blow: it staggers anything short of an elite, moves nobody, and shatters every stone of yours in its arc.
skills.verb_fit: Crumble is "break stone and guard": it breaks both - their guard (80 poise) and your stone (it shatters it).

good_modifiers.word: Held Landslide: hold it longer for a heavier blow
Shaking Landslide: longer reach, more poise
Rockfall Blow: those it breaks are Stunned

bad_modifiers.why: a blow has nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
nothing lasts; falls back
nobody moves - that is the point; falls back

skills.name: Raise Slab
skills.summary: A wall of stone across your aim, up to 8 m away. It blocks movement and shots - theirs and yours - for 12 s. Three at a time.
skills.verb_fit: Raise is "stone up": the plainest stone there is, a wall where you point.

good_modifiers.word: Lasting Slab: stands half as long again

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite in spirit (a wall that breaks as it rises), and a slab has no poise field: falls back to a little power
nothing to pierce; falls back
a wall does not move; falls back

skills.name: Pillar
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a circle is marked for half a second, then a column punches up - 120, 60 poise, interrupts - and stays as stone.
skills.verb_fit: Raise as an attack: the stone comes up through whoever is standing on the spot, and stays.

good_modifiers.word: Snap Pillar: marked and up sooner
Lasting Pillar: the column stands longer
Crashing Pillar: whoever it hits is Stunned

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a column that rises into a pit. Maths lets it act (Mired); it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back
a column does not travel; falls back

skills.name: Stonehide
skills.summary: 8 s Braced: 40% less damage, and nothing staggers or shoves you. You move 25% slower.
skills.verb_fit: Harden is "solidify, armour": you turn your own skin to stone for a while.

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: breaking the stone you are wearing; no poise field, falls back to a cost cut
nothing to pierce; falls back
a hide has no reach; falls back

skills.name: Bedrock Shove
skills.summary: Shoulder first, 3.5 m, Braced throughout. The first enemy you meet is thrown 3 m and loses 50 poise; a heavy one stops you dead and loses 60.
skills.verb_fit: Root is "anchor, stand firm": the one dash in the game you make Braced, as an immovable thing.

good_modifiers.word: Rockfall Shove: the body you hit is Stunned

bad_modifiers.why: it is meant to stop at the body; going under it has nothing to act on and falls back
nothing lasts; falls back
it has no wind-up to shorten; falls back

skills.name: Tremor
skills.summary: Everything within 5 m takes 60, is interrupted and slowed for 3 s - and every stone you have standing shatters outward at once.
skills.verb_fit: Quake is "shake, unbalance": the whole floor around you shakes, everything standing on it loses its footing.

good_modifiers.word: Burying Tremor: Pinned, not just slowed

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, and it is already Braced: falls back to a little power
nothing to pierce; falls back
nothing travels; falls back

skills.name: Quarry Throw
skills.summary: Hold to tear a boulder out of the floor (rooted and Braced, up to 1.5 s), release to lob it at the cursor, up to 14 m. 150 to 400 damage in 2.5 m by how long you held, 80 poise, and it leaves rubble: a stone that also slows enemies within 2 m of it by 40%.
skills.verb_fit: Dig is "tear into the ground and bring stone up to throw": the biggest piece of ground you can tear up, thrown.

new_mechanics.name: new:charge_release
new_mechanics.definition: design/05 Appendix A behaviour 9 (not built): hold to charge, release fires a delayed_blast whose damage runs from damage to damage_full over charge_max.

good_modifiers.word: Mountain Throw: hold longer, hit harder

bad_modifiers.why: a lobbed boulder has nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
it is already Braced while it charges; falls back
the boulder already flies; there is no speed field to act on, so it falls back to a little power

skills.name: Sinkhole
skills.summary: Point, 9 m, 0.5 s wind-up (Braced): the floor drops into a pit 2.5 m across for 10 s. Enemies standing there fall in for 30 damage and 40 poise. Inside they are Mired and need 1.5 s to climb out; enemies walk round it, and shots fly over it. It counts as one of your three stones.
skills.verb_fit: Sink is "ground down, pits": the opposite of raising stone, and it stays like stone does.

new_mechanics.name: prop shape "pit"
new_mechanics.definition: A prop that is a hole, not a block: it does not block shots; enemies path round it; anyone inside is Mired and needs climb_out_s to leave; it counts toward the caster's stone limit and is not shattered (shatter on it does nothing).

new_mechanics.name: climb_out_s
new_mechanics.definition: Seconds an enemy inside a pit needs to climb out.

good_modifiers.word: Falling Floor: whoever drops in is Stunned

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a pit that rises. Maths lets it act (poise); it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
a pit does not travel; falls back

skills.name: Cairn
skills.summary: One enemy within 8 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): earth heaps over it. It is Buried for 2.5 s - it cannot move or act, and blows land on the stone, not on it. Shatter the cairn (Slingstone, Landslide Blow, Tremor) and the one inside takes 120 and is Staggered. Elites are Pinned instead. The cairn counts as one of your three stones.
skills.verb_fit: Bury is "cover over with earth": one body, covered, and the cover is your stone.

new_mechanics.name: new:seize
new_mechanics.definition: Same as water.json: an instant effect on one enemy under the cursor within range; walls and stone block it. Here with a wind-up.

new_mechanics.name: buried
new_mechanics.definition: Lasts the skill's duration. Cannot move or act; hits on it land on the cairn (a stone of the caster's with 150 health) instead. Elites take Pinned instead.

new_mechanics.name: shatter_bonus
new_mechanics.definition: When a cairn is shattered, the enemy inside takes this much and is Staggered, besides the normal shrapnel.

good_modifiers.word: Grinding Cairn: more poise as it closes

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: tearing up the ground you are covering them with. Maths lets it act (power and cost); it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back
a cairn does not travel; falls back

skills.name: Burrow
skills.summary: 0.3 s wind-up (Braced), then you go under the floor and come up 6 m on, 0.4 s later, passing beneath enemies, stone and shots (a slam on the ground can still find you). Where you surface the ground heaves: enemies within 1.5 m lose 40 poise and are pushed 1.5 m off. Surface beside your own stone and it shatters away from you.
skills.verb_fit: Tunnel is "pass through the ground": the only way an earth fighter gets past anything is under it.

new_mechanics.name: under
new_mechanics.definition: A dash that goes under the floor: it passes beneath bodies, stone and shots; ground attacks (slams, zones) still hit you. It does not make you untouchable.

good_modifiers.word: Heaving Burrow: a wider heave where you come up (its poise half has no field to act on yet)
Wide Breach: the heave reaches farther round you

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: the tunnel caving in on you. Maths lets it act (a Stun on surfacing); it should not
it is already Braced, and anchoring is the opposite of travelling: falls back to a little power
nothing lasts; falls back

skills.name: Cave-In
skills.summary: Dear. Point, 10 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): rock comes down on a 3 m circle a full second later. Everything still under it takes 130 and 70 poise and is Stunned for 1 s, elites included. The rubble stays for 15 s: nothing can walk through it, but shots pass over. It counts as one of your three stones.
skills.verb_fit: Collapse is "bring the ground down and close a passage": it brings it down on them and the heap shuts the way.

new_mechanics.name: blocks_shots false
new_mechanics.definition: A prop that blocks walking but not shots (a low heap).

good_modifiers.word: Lasting Heap: the rubble stays longer

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, and nothing to pierce: falls back to a little power
rock falls, it does not travel; falls back
lifts Aloft what the rock is falling on. Maths lets it act; it should not
